item.title: Mixed-Initiative AI Assistant for Reading 10-K Filings
item.description:
Dual-panel system with in-situ explanation, reasoning visualization, and source tracing for reading lengthy SEC filings. Controlled experiments (N=24×3) raised hallucination detection from 52% to 78%.

May 2026 – Present · First author (in preparation, target: CHI)
